description: Reproducible inputs and expected outputs for the Symptom Triage Journal. Used by examples/run_examples.py to demonstrate end-to-end inference. Probabilities will vary slightly with sklearn version but disease + severity should match.

examples.input: I have a runny nose, sore throat and mild cough since yesterday.
Severe chest pain and shortness of breath, sweating a lot.
Burning urination and frequent urge to go to the bathroom.
Yellow skin, dark urine and constant fatigue for a week.
High fever with shaking chills, severe pain in muscles, and sweating profusely.
Itchy red blisters all over body with mild fever.
